```{r metrics}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# Count entries in this file by splitting each section into paragraphs
# (blank-line separated) and keeping those that mention **PROVETE.
src <- paste(readLines("publications.qmd"), collapse = "\n")

count_in_section <- function(text, start, end) {
  pat <- sprintf("(?s)## %s\\s*\\n(.*?)(?=\\n## |\\Z)", start)
  m   <- regmatches(text, regexpr(pat, text, perl = TRUE))
  if (!length(m)) return(0L)
  body  <- sub(pat, "\\1", m, perl = TRUE)
  paras <- strsplit(body, "\\n\\s*\\n")[[1]]
  sum(grepl("\\*\\*PROVETE", paras, fixed = FALSE))
}

n_pr     <- count_in_section(src, "Peer-reviewed articles")
n_inrev  <- count_in_section(src, "In review")
n_inprep <- count_in_section(src, "In preparation")

# Read cached scholarship metrics (refresh via Rscript R/update_metrics.R)
m <- tryCatch(yaml::read_yaml("_metrics.yml"), error = function(e) NULL)
cites   <- if (!is.null(m)) m$citations else NA
h_index <- if (!is.null(m)) m$h_index   else NA
updated <- if (!is.null(m)) m$updated   else NA

cat('<div class="metrics-row">\n')
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span class="num">%d</span><span class="label">Peer-reviewed</span></div>\n', n_pr))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span class="num">%d</span><span class="label">In review</span></div>\n', n_inrev))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span class="num">%d</span><span class="label">In preparation</span></div>\n', n_inprep))
if (!is.na(cites))   cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span class="num">%s</span><span class="label">Citations</span></div>\n', format(cites, big.mark = ",")))
if (!is.na(h_index)) cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span class="num">%d</span><span class="label">h-index</span></div>\n', h_index))
cat('</div>\n')

if (!is.na(updated)) {
  cat(sprintf('<p class="metrics-foot">Citations and h-index from <a href="https://scholar.google.com.br/citations?user=qDwcLvIAAAAJ" target="_blank">Google Scholar</a>, last updated %s.</p>\n',
              format(as.Date(updated), "%B %Y")))
} else {
  cat('<p class="metrics-foot">Live citation count on <a href="https://scholar.google.com.br/citations?user=qDwcLvIAAAAJ" target="_blank">Google Scholar</a>.</p>\n')
}
```
